seo.meta_title: Sexy Fish Miami Dress Code, Hours and Reservations
seo.meta_description: Sexy Fish Miami favors a glamorous dress code: no shorts, flip-flops, slides, Crocs, hats or sportswear. Plus hours, reservations and what to expect.
seo.h1: Sexy Fish Miami Dress Code and Reservations

question: What Is the Dress Code at Sexy Fish Miami?
quick_answer: Sexy Fish Miami says it favors a glamorous dress code. Shorts, casual slides, flip-flops, beach shoes, Crocs and plastic or foam shoes aren't allowed, and hats, caps, beachwear and sportswear are also out. OpenTable lists the standard as smart casual, but the room dresses up, especially on weekends. You'll need a reservation to get past the velvet rope at 1001 S. Miami Ave. in Brickell. It's open from noon to midnight Sunday through Wednesday and noon to 2 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
key_facts: Glamorous dress code; listed as smart casual
No shorts, slides, flip-flops, Crocs, hats or sportswear

body.heading: The dress code
body.text: Sexy Fish's own wording says you're welcome if you dress with personality and originality, but that it favors a glamorous dress code. The restaurant's posted rules say shorts, casual slides, flip-flops, beach shoes, Crocs and plastic or foam shoes aren't permitted, and hats, caps, beachwear and sportswear are also not allowed. OpenTable lists the dress code as smart casual. In practice, think date-night outfits: dresses, heels or dressy flats, collared or dressy shirts, and nice trousers or dark jeans. Weekday lunch skews business, and weekend nights get dressier.

body.heading: How strictly it's enforced
body.text: Sexy Fish Miami does turn people away at the door, and a few guests have complained publicly that the rules were applied unevenly. The restaurant has said that everyone following the dress code is welcome. The safest move is to dress up a notch and avoid anything on the banned list.

body.heading: Reservations and hours
body.text: Reservations are needed to get through the velvet rope and can be made on OpenTable, which shows it among Miami's most-booked restaurants. Listed hours are noon to midnight Sunday through Wednesday and noon to 2 a.m. Thursday through Saturday, with lunch, brunch and dinner. The phone number is (305) 889-7888. Valet parking is available, and the Metromover's Tenth Street Promenade station is right across the street.

body.heading: What it's like
body.text: Sexy Fish opened in Brickell in February 2022 as the London brand's first location outside the UK. The menu is Japanese-inspired seafood: sushi, sashimi and dishes from a robata grill, plus a large tequila and mezcal collection at the bar. Expect a loud, high-energy room with flashy decor and late-night entertainment. It's very expensive; see our Sexy Fish Miami menu for prices.

faqs.q: Does Sexy Fish Miami have a dress code?
faqs.a: Yes. It favors a glamorous look and bans shorts, flip-flops, slides, Crocs, plastic shoes, hats, caps, beachwear and sportswear.

faqs.q: Can you wear jeans to Sexy Fish Miami?
faqs.a: Dark, nice jeans with a dressy top are usually fine. Shorts are not allowed.

faqs.q: Can you wear sneakers to Sexy Fish Miami?
faqs.a: Sportswear isn't allowed, so athletic sneakers are risky. Dress shoes or clean, stylish shoes are safer.

faqs.q: Do you need a reservation for Sexy Fish Miami?
faqs.a: Yes, a reservation is the way in past the velvet rope. Book on OpenTable.

faqs.q: What are Sexy Fish Miami's hours?
faqs.a: Noon to midnight Sunday through Wednesday and noon to 2 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
